subject: AWS co-sell: Aurionix - marketplace listing & joint account plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@aurionix.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: AWS co-sell: Aurionix - marketplace listing & joint account plan

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We talked internally and would love to take the next step toward a co-sell listing with AWS and a joint account plan for the ACME pilot you mentioned. High-level asks from my side:

- Confirm Aurionix is comfortable with the public listing draft and any redlines (we can field legal/marketing questions).
- Align on a 30–45 minute sync next week to map buying personas and procurement milestones for the pilot.
- Build a short mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and dates — I started a draft (attached).

Proposed times (PDT): Tue 7/16 10:00–10:45, Wed 7/17 14:00–14:45, Thu 7/18 09:00–09:45. If none of these work, please share availability and I’ll coordinate.

I’ve looped in Kimberly (marketplace ops) and Karthik (co-sell lead) to help scope the listing and joint outreach to AWS field.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: RNW-AUR-MAP-v0.3.pdf (pdf), aurionix-aws-listing-draft.md (markdown)

From: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@aurionix.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@aurionix.com>, MarketplaceOps <marketplace-ops@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: Aurionix - marketplace listing & joint account plan

Mina —

Appreciate the follow-up and the MAP draft. Priya and I reviewed the listing draft and left a few inline comments; attaching a cleaned copy. We’re excited to work with Redwood and AWS field on a pilot with ACME.

Times: Wed 7/17 14:00 (works for us) — we can block 45 minutes.

Quick notes:
- Legal will want to see the public listing blurb; we have a short approval turn (2–3 business days).
- We’d like to add a short technical checklist to the MAP (integration points + data residency callouts).

Onwards — I’ll accept a calendar invite for 7/17 14:00 PDT and loop in our solutions engineer if needed.

Thanks,
Evan Shaw
Head of GTM Operations
Aurionix
evan.shaw@aurionix.com | (617) 555-0199

Attachments: aurionix-aws-listing-draft-reviewed.md (markdown)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@aurionix.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@aurionix.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: Aurionix - marketplace listing & joint account plan

Thanks Evan — perfect, I’ll send the invite for Wed 7/17 14:00 PDT.

Agenda (45m):
1) Intros + success criteria for the pilot (5m)
2) Marketplace copy and approvals path (10m)
3) Joint account plan — roles, timing, and primary outreach to ACME (15m)
4) Technical checklist and integration points (10m)
5) Next steps and owners (5m)

Kimberly — can you confirm the submission windows for AWS marketplace (typical lead times, certs we should expect)? Karthik — can you prepare a 3-slide summary of the co-sell motion and our proposed field ask to AWS? I’ve attached the MAP and a first-pass listing blurb for comments.

I’ll include links to the MAP in the invite and a HubSpot deal record for the joint plan.

Best,
Mina

Attachments: RNW-AUR-MAP-v0.3.pdf, aurionix-aws-listing-draft.md

- I’ll bring a 3-slide one-pager on the co-sell ask to AWS field (who we want to engage and suggested timeline).
